claim: A defendant's continued detention after the completion of a traffic stop and subsequent probable cause vehicle search constitutes an illegal seizure when the detention is prolonged beyond what was reasonably necessary to accomplish the purposes of the stop.
initial_reasoning: 209 NE 3d 830 (Neb. 2015) held that a defendant’s continued detention after a traffic stop, when extended beyond what was reasonably necessary to accomplish the stop’s purpose, constitutes an illegal seizure. The court emphasized that any post‑stop detention must be limited to the time required for the officer to complete the stop’s objectives, thereby supporting the claim.
